provenance.dp_table: runs before the repair keyed the DP table by x only; opposite points at one x would have been read as equal. Every recorded run recovered the planted logarithm, so none was affected; the repaired engine stores y and handles both cases
provenance.hash_scope: the recorded `hash` counter holds the partition hash only; the DP-check hash (all arms) and the two cycle-window hashes (negation arms) were evaluated but not counted. Native work used for S+ and the 5a band adds them, derived from the recorded step count (1 per step plain, 3 per step with negation); S_plus_harness_as_recorded keeps the recorded scope
provenance.raw_runs: produced by the jv_cover binary built from commit 8f21253f7 (jv_rho_strong.rs there is identical to later commits up to rustfmt); no run was repeated after code repairs
